lines.en: label dormwartwo10:
scene scavengerhunt1
$ totaldays += 1
$ day += 1
show sunday
: Good morning, everyone. I hope you slept well since the competition you’re about to take part in is likely going to consume the majority of your day.
lines.zh: : 大家早上好。希望你们睡得不错，因为你们即将参加的这场比赛，大概会吃掉你们这一天的大部分时间。

lines.en: : That’s right, gals! Silence them phones and button those blouses cause these next few hours are gonna have you wishing you were drawn for the date war instead!
lines.zh: : 没错，姑娘们！把手机调静音，把衬衫扣子扣好，因为接下来这几个小时，会让你恨不得自己被抽中去参加约会大战！

lines.en: : But I {i}was{/i} drawn for the date war.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}确实{/i}被抽中去参加约会大战了啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, just brag about it, why don’t you? Real nice, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 是吗，那你就使劲炫耀啊，为什么不呢？真是太好了，Noriko。

lines.en: : So, what are the rules for this exactly? Is there an entire list of things we have to find or...is this going to be one of those scavenger hunts where we need to inconvenience other people in order to win?
lines.zh: : 那么，规则到底是什么？是要找一整张清单上的东西，还是……会是那种为了获胜非得去麻烦别人的寻宝游戏？

lines.en: : Also, is this really going to take that long? Because I was kind of hoping I’d get to see the maid war thing.
lines.zh: : 还有，真的要花那么久吗？因为我还挺想去看女仆大战的。

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt2
: The maid war is actually going to be starting in about an hour. So unless you find the {i}one{/i} item on the list almost immediately, I can’t imagine you’re going to make it.
lines.zh: : 女仆大战其实大概{i}一{/i}小时后就要开始了。所以除非你们几乎立刻就找到清单上那样东西，否则我想你们是赶不上的。

lines.en: : Ugh, seriously? I wanted to see Io in a dress.
lines.zh: : 呃，真的假的？我还想看 Io 穿裙子呢。

lines.en: : Please. Io in a dress? You’re more likely to see {i}me{/i} in a pair of khakis.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。Io 穿裙子？你还不如期待看{i}我{/i}穿卡其裤呢。

lines.en: : I have literally seen that before.
lines.zh: : 我还真见过你穿。

lines.en: : Pfft. As if. Khakis are so outdated it’s, like...not even funny anymore.
lines.zh: : 切。才怪。卡其裤土得……都已经不好笑了。

lines.en: : When were they ever funny?
lines.zh: : 它们什么时候好笑过？

lines.en: : Do you guys actually want to hear the rules? Or would you rather sit here and talk about pants for the next hour or two?
lines.zh: : 你们到底想不想听规则？还是说你们宁愿坐在这儿，接下来一两个小时都聊裤子？

lines.en: : Obvs the pants, Makoto. But it ain’t like I expect you to understand with that two layered crop top combo you’ve got going on. Ugh, talk about elementary school. Am I right?
lines.zh: : 当然是裤子，Makoto。不过就凭你身上那套双层露脐装，我也不指望你能懂。呃，简直小学生穿的，对吧？

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt3
: I don’t like this side of you.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你这个样子。

lines.en: : Settle. You’re killing the vibe.
lines.zh: : 消停点。你把气氛都毁了。

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt4
mak" Hah..."
lines.zh: mak" 哈……"

lines.en: : Somewhere in the residential section of the old district, Miku and I have hidden one of her old soccer trophies.
lines.zh: : 在旧城区住宅区的某处，Miku 和我藏起了她以前的一个足球奖杯。

lines.en: : Whichever pair of you finds it first will be crowned the victor and earn your floor a point for the Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 你们中哪一对先找到它，就是获胜者，并能为你们楼层在宿舍大战中拿下一分。

lines.en: : Maps of the area will be provided for anyone who wants them. It is also urged to not approach any of the homeless people you may find wandering the streets. Please be careful.
lines.zh: : 想要地图的人可以拿到该区域的地图。另外强烈建议不要靠近任何你们可能在街上遇到的流浪汉。请务必小心。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Each competitor has chosen a partner for this contest, and those partners are free to assist in whichever ways they see fit.
lines.zh: : 每位参赛者都为这场比赛选了一位搭档，这些搭档可以以任何她们认为合适的方式提供帮助。

lines.en: : However, this does not include sabotaging the other team’s search...and any attempt to do so will be met with a disqualification.
lines.zh: : 但这不包括破坏另一队的搜寻……任何此类尝试都会导致取消资格。

lines.en: : Ugh, darn it! There goes our plan.
lines.zh: : 呃，可恶！我们的计划泡汤了。

lines.en: : Makocchi and I will be hangin’ out around here and waitin’ for y’all to come back with the trophy. But if it winds up taking too long, we’ll probs just peace it and go chill somewhere else. SNS.
lines.zh: : 我和 Makocchi 会在这附近待着，等你们带着奖杯回来。不过要是拖太久，我们大概就先撤了，去别的地方凉快。SNS。

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt5
: Do we need one of those maps? Because I’m not really into the idea of, you know, {i}not{/i} winning Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我们需要拿一张地图吗？因为我可不太喜欢……你知道的，{i}赢不到{/i}老师这个结局。

lines.en: : We do not. I know these streets like the back of my hand, so you definitely made the right choice in choosing me as your partner.
lines.zh: : 不需要。这些街道我熟得像自己的手背，所以你选我当搭档绝对没错。

lines.en: : Well, who else was I going to choose? Because, as far as I’m concerned, Miku won’t even exist again until Monday.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不选你还能选谁？在我看来，Miku 到星期一之前根本就不存在。

lines.en: : Also, the longer I get to look at you in that costume, the better. Please never wear your normal clothes again. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 还有，能多看你穿这身一会儿就多好。请你以后永远别再穿平时的衣服了。谢谢。

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt6
: Thanks, Kirin. I’d like to say the same to you but you are legit whoring it up right now.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Kirin。我也想这么说你，不过你现在是真的骚得不行。

lines.en: : In the trashy way? Or the way that makes you want to bone me?
lines.zh: : 是那种低俗的骚？还是让你想干我的那种骚？

lines.en: : Those things don’t have to be mutually exclusive. I can guarantee you I’ll have at least one dream about this in the near future.
lines.zh: : 这两样又不必互相排斥。我可以保证，不久的将来我至少会做一次关于这个的梦。

lines.en: : That’s good enough for me. But keep in mind that my bed is always ten feet away and that you can always-
lines.zh: : 那对我来说就够好了。不过记住，我的床永远就在十英尺开外，而你随时都可——

lines.en: : For the love of all that is holy just make out already!
lines.zh: : 看在老天爷的份上，你们干脆直接亲上去吧！

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt7
: I swear, you two are less like roommates and more like...I don’t know. People who want to have sex with each other.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，你们两个与其说像室友，不如说像……我不知道。像两个想跟对方上床的人。

lines.en: : That’s not a fair assessment when Kirin wants to have sex with literally everyone.
lines.zh: : 这话不公平，因为 Kirin 想和所有人上床好吧。

lines.en: : Not {i}everyone.{/i} Yasu gives me the creeps.
lines.zh: : 也不是{i}所有人{/i}。Yasu 让我发毛。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. We both know the crazy ones are always the best lays.
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托。我们俩都知道，疯的那种人上起来才最爽。

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt8
: How do you know that when the closest {i}you’ve{/i} ever come to getting fucked is the time you slipped in the bathhouse and wound up on top of me?
lines.zh: : 你哪儿来的经验说这话？{i}你{/i}最接近被操的一次，还是在澡堂滑倒、然后压在我身上的那回呢。

lines.en: : Let the record show that I still don’t appreciate what you did with your knee back then.
lines.zh: : 请记录在案：你当时用膝盖干的那些事，我到现在都不领情。

lines.en: : Want to...maybe start looking for the trophy? Seems like Makoto and Miku have already stopped paying attention to us.
lines.zh: : 要不……我们开始找奖杯吧？看起来 Makoto 和 Miku 已经不理我们了。

lines.en: : I don’t blame them with the world’s horniest dorm room over there being all...horny and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我不怪她们，那边那个全世界最色的宿舍，正在那儿……发情什么的。

lines.en: : I should probably get one of those maps, though, since neither one of us has any idea where we are right now.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概该去拿张地图，毕竟我们两个现在都不知道自己在哪儿。

lines.en: : You should probably get one too. Since we’re not allowed to sabotage floor two’s plans, it might be best if we change our strategy and split up so we can cover more ground.
lines.zh: : 你大概也该拿一张。既然我们不许去破坏二楼的计划，那最好的办法可能是改变策略、分头行动，这样能覆盖更大的范围。

lines.en: : Do you, uhh...
: Do you really think that would be for the best?
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得那样最好吗？

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt9
: Hm? Do you have a better idea?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你有更好的主意吗？

lines.en: : Just...I kind of figured staying together would make more sense. It’s easy to get lost around here and...we could look out for each other if those homeless people are actually threatening.
lines.zh: : 只是……我总觉得待在一起更合理。这一带很容易走丢，而且……如果那些流浪汉真的有威胁，我们还能互相照应。

lines.en: : I mean...I guess that’s okay, but...we’re already dealing with a bit of a disadvantage since Noriko is from around here.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我觉得也行，不过……我们本来就有点吃亏，因为 Noriko 就是这一带的人。

lines.en: : Yeah but, at this rate, the two of them might not ever start looking and will just waste away the rest of the day by “being horny and stuff.”
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过照这个速度，她们两个可能根本就不会开始找，只会靠「发情什么的」把剩下的一天耗掉。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. We’ll figure out a way to fully utilize the strength of two sets of eyes in one place. But if we wind up losing a point over this decision, I am going to have your head.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。我们会想办法把两双眼睛集中在一处的优势发挥到极致。不过如果我们因为这个决定丢了一分，我拿你是问。

lines.en: : Is that fair when I’ve already {i}earned{/i} us one point?
lines.zh: : 可我已经给咱们{i}挣了{/i}一分了啊，这公平吗？

lines.en: : Yes. A million times yes. And don’t try to convince me otherwise because serious-mode Ami is not having any of that today.
lines.zh: : 公平。一百万个公平。别想说服我改主意，因为认真模式的 Ami 今天可不吃这一套。

lines.en: scene black
: Makoto! Map, please!
lines.zh: : Makoto！地图，谢谢！

lines.en: : Oh, good. I was beginning to think I went to the effort of drawing them for nothing.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。我刚才还以为我费劲画这些地图是白画了呢。

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt10
: Good luck. And please let Ayane hold the map as I’m not sure you possess the mental capacity to actually read it.
lines.zh: : 祝好运。另外请把地图交给 Ayane 拿着，因为我不确定你有没有读懂它的脑力。

lines.en: : Of course I can read a friggin’ map! Who do you think I am?!
lines.zh: : 我当然看得懂一张破地图！你以为我是谁啊？！

lines.en: : Some sort of gremlin perhaps?
lines.zh: : 也许是某种小怪物？

lines.en: : Ain’t you two friends now?
lines.zh: : 你们两个现在不是朋友了吗？

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt11
: Who? Ami and me? Don’t be ridiculous. The only reason I’ve started going over her house is to tutor her.
lines.zh: : 谁？Ami 和我？别开玩笑了。我开始去她家，唯一的理由就是给她补课。

lines.en: : Friends ain’t supposed to lie to each other, {i}Makocchi.{/i}
lines.zh: : 朋友之间不该互相说谎的，{i}Makocchi{/i}。

lines.en: : And stop calling me Makocchi or I’m never doing your hair again. This new persona of yours is going to your head.
lines.zh: : 还有别再叫我 Makocchi，不然我再也不给你做头发了。你这个新的人设已经冲昏你的头了。

lines.en: scene black
: Sure thing, Makocchi. Just don’t leave me for Ami, kay?
lines.zh: : 没问题，Makocchi。只是别为了 Ami 把我丢下，好吗？

lines.en: : I’m tempted to just leave you as a whole right now...
lines.zh: : 我现在就挺想把你整个人丢下的……

lines.en: {i}A while later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}过了一会儿……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Like, a long while. Not a short one.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我是说，很长的一会儿。不是短的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Let’s say it’s about an hour.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}大概是一个小时吧。{/i}

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt12
: Is it just me, or does the sky look unusually pink today?
lines.zh: : 是我一个人的错觉吗，还是今天的天空粉得反常？

lines.en: : I think that means tomorrow is supposed to bring good weather. It’s some old superstition or something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那意味着明天会是好天气。是什么古老的迷信之类的。

lines.en: : How does that even happen anyway? I thought the sky was blue because of, like...the ocean.
lines.zh: : 那到底是怎么来的？我还以为天空是蓝的，是因为……大海。

lines.en: : The way air molecules scatter light means sometimes redirecting the colors with shorter wavelengths like blue or green away from us.
lines.zh: : 空气分子散射光线的方式，意味着有时会把蓝色或绿色这类波长较短的颜色从我们这边引开。

lines.en: : But there’s still some blue out there.
lines.zh: : 可外面还是有点蓝啊。

lines.en: : I’m not a fucking meteorologist, Kirin. I don’t know what you want from me.
lines.zh: : 我又不是他妈的气象学家，Kirin。我不知道你想让我说什么。

lines.en: : Some assistance in...literally anything would be nice. We haven’t even started looking for the trophy yet.
lines.zh: : 帮我一点忙……哪怕是任何一点忙都好。我们连奖杯都还没开始找呢。

lines.en: : We don’t have to {i}look{/i} when I already know where it is.
lines.zh: : 我都已经知道它在哪儿了，还{i}找{/i}什么。

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt13
: Are you kidding?! I’m missing the maids because of you!
lines.zh: : 你开玩笑吧？！我因为你都错过女仆大战了！

lines.en: : Well excuse me for creating the perfect opportunity for you to ask about how my date went last night.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉啊，我给你创造了一个绝佳的机会，让你能问问我昨晚的约会怎么样。

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt14
: Wait. Does that mean you finally-
lines.zh: : 等等。那意思是你终于——

lines.en: : No. I did not fuck him.
lines.zh: : 不。我没和他上床。

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt15
: Sounds like a pretty shitty date, then.
lines.zh: : 那听起来这场约会挺烂的。

lines.en: : We don’t all need sex in order to feel alive, you know.
lines.zh: : 不是所有人都非得靠性才能感觉自己活着，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Also, how do you know where the trophy is already? Aren’t you worried that Ayane and Ami are going to find it?
lines.zh: : 还有，你怎么已经知道奖杯在哪儿了？你就不担心 Ayane 和 Ami 会先找到吗？

lines.en: : See that huge bush? Beside the abandoned house with the blue roof? If you look closely, you can see the trophy tucked away in there.
lines.zh: : 看到那丛大灌木了吗？就在那栋蓝色屋顶的废弃房子旁边？仔细看的话，你能看见奖杯就塞在里面。

lines.en: : If Ami and Ayane get close, I’ll slide down this ledge assassin-style and do a cool flip or something before swiping it up for us.
lines.zh: : 要是 Ami 和 Ayane 靠近了，我就从这堵岩壁上刺客式地滑下去，来个帅气的空翻什么的，然后把它抢到手。

lines.en: : I think we should go get it now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们现在就该去拿。

lines.en: : I think you’re only saying that because you don’t want to talk about how my date went for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你这么说，只是因为不知道为什么你不想聊我的约会。

lines.en: : And oh boy...I wonder what that reason could possibly be.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪……我真好奇那会是什么原因。

lines.en: : Not this again, please. I already told you I don’t feel that way about him.
lines.zh: : 别又来了，拜托。我已经说过我对他没有那种感觉。

lines.en: : And how many more times do you think you’ll need to tell {i}yourself{/i} that before you actually believe it?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得你还要再对{i}自己{/i}说多少次，才会真的相信这句话？

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt16
: Fine. Tell me how your stupid, sexless date went. Did you do that thing you were talking about? Or did you wind up chickening out instead?
lines.zh: : 好吧。那就告诉我你那场蠢得要命、没有性的约会怎么样。你做了你说的那件事吗？还是最后临阵退缩了？

lines.en: : I did it. And I’m pretty sure I got through to him as well.
lines.zh: : 我做了。而且我挺确定，我打动了他。

lines.en: if datewarnoriko == True:
: No wonder you won, then. A grand gesture like that isn’t going to fail to someone like Futaba who probably just read him a fucking book or something.
lines.zh: : 那你赢了也不奇怪了。那么盛大的一番心意，怎么可能输给 Futaba 那种大概只是给他念了本破书的人。

lines.en: : Futaba is sweet and I’m sure her date went well too.
lines.zh: : Futaba 很温柔，我相信她的约会也很顺利。

lines.en: : And yes, I did win. But that victory is just one small step in what is going to be an all-out war for my future. And having someone to talk to about that war would mean a lot to me.
lines.zh: : 是的，我赢了。但那场胜利只是我将要为我的未来打一场全面战争中的一小步。而能有个人聊聊那场战争，对我来说意义重大。

lines.en: : That lovey-dovey stuff doesn’t sit right with me. So here’s hoping you find a different friend in the near future so I can go back to being a feelingless fuck buddy.
lines.zh: : 那种卿卿我我的东西我可受不了。所以我只指望你不久的将来能找到别的朋友，好让我变回那个没有感情的炮友。

lines.en: : If you’re going to refuse to be happy yourself, at least be happy for {i}me.{/i} There’s no need to rob yourself of {i}every single{/i} positive emotion that comes your way.
lines.zh: : 如果你自己不肯幸福，至少为{i}我{/i}高兴一下吧。没必要把{i}每一个{/i}降临到你身上的正面情绪都剥夺掉。

lines.en: : Keep talking and I’m going to feel obligated to pay you for this spontaneous counseling session.
lines.zh: : 你再说下去，我都要觉得自己该为这场即兴心理辅导付钱了。

lines.en: : I just wanted you to know I did well.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你知道，我做得很好。

lines.en: : And that I’m going to keep doing well.
lines.zh: : 还有，我会继续做得很好。

lines.en: : So your time is running out.
lines.zh: : 所以你的时间在一点点耗尽。

lines.en: scene black
: Sucks for me, then...I guess.
lines.zh: : 那对我来说挺惨的……大概吧。

lines.en: : Hah...
: Come on, let’s go get ourselves a point.
lines.zh: : 走吧，我们去把那一分拿到手。

lines.en: else:
scene scavengerhunt17
: What? Then how the fuck did you lose?
lines.zh: : 什么？那你他妈是怎么输的？

lines.en: : Probably {i}because{/i} I got through to him, if I had to guess.
lines.zh: : 如果让我猜的话，大概就是{i}因为{/i}我把话传到了他心里。

lines.en: scene scavengerhunt18
: Sensei’s been weird with feelings for as long as I’ve known him. But things got way worse after Ami’s parents died in an accident.
lines.zh: : 从我认识老师起，他在感情上就一直很怪。但在 Ami 的父母死于一场意外之后，情况变得更糟了。

lines.en: : For a while after that, I didn’t get to see him at all. But when I finally {i}did...{/i}he felt like a different person, almost.
lines.zh: : 在那之后的一段时间里，我根本见不到他。可等我终于{i}见到{/i}他时……他几乎像是变了一个人。

lines.en: : Or...maybe less like a different person and more like there was some kind of impenetrable layer around him, preventing anything from getting through.
lines.zh: : 或者……与其说是变了一个人，不如说他周围多了一层无法穿透的东西，让什么都进不去。

lines.en: : Imagine that’s you. Imagine you grow so used to feeling nothing that when you finally {i}do{/i} feel something, you can’t figure out how to process it.
